==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Da:''' Ah, what a nice day. It's perfect for soaking up some sun
:{{DIcon}} Don't you have to work?
:'''Da:''' Yeah, yeah, I'll get to it in a bit. Absolutely. You bet. No rush here. Why the worry, {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Ms.}} Not-My-Boss?
:'''Da:''' [[Peipei]] never seems to run out of energy... Hard to say what keeps her so busy.
:'''Da:''' Watching her go is exhausting. That's it, I definitely need a break now...
{{Dialogue End}}
